notes.title: Weekly Update & Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Keepers of Tidehaven![/h2][p]As we near the end of the Playtest, we’re rolling out a [b]small update[/b] packed with fixes and improvements—thanks to your feedback and the remaining items on our list.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]What's Fixed?[/h3][list][*][p]Bed placement and spawn issues in the [b]Bedroom[/b] have been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Walls no longer change color at random.[/p][/*][*][p]That wild wall cabinet in the Bedroom? No more transforming into a medieval Optimus Prime.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]item menu opened[/b] while painting the floor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a decoration bug related to the [b]Wooden Cask[/b] item.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simple Wooden Work Table[/b] rotation issue is now working as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor placement issues in the [b]Kitchen[/b] have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Bartender’s Auto-Buy[/b] setting no longer resets after closing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the placement bug with the [b]Kitchen Shelf[/b] item.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fireplace audio bug[/b] is resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]The infamous [b]Always-on-Top[/b] bug is no more.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Switch Monitor[/b] key is now functional, jump between screens as you please![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]What's Updated?[/h3][list][*][p]Customization options like [b]columns, wall panels, and floor tiles[/b] are now fully integrated into the in-game economy.[/p][/*][*][p]Several items can now be used in more room types.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cooking speed[/b] and [b]dish prices[/b] have been rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the price of various items.[/p][/*][*][p]A major [b]sound overhaul[/b] is in progress—many new effects are now in, with more coming in future patches.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto-save frequency[/b] has been increased, helping protect your progress during unexpected shutdowns.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][p]We promised fast-paced improvements and the next wave is a big one:[/p][list][*][p][b]Beyond the Inn:[/b] Starting in the [b]first week of August[/b], you'll step outside and begin shaping your [b]Town[/b], establishing new businesses beyond your inn’s cozy walls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Horse Breeding:[/b] One of our animal-focused features is arriving soon. Build your [b]Stable[/b], raise fine horses, and trade them for serious coin.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mini Games:[/b] Three new activities—[b]Coin Flip[/b], [b]Dice Roll[/b], and a card game called [b]Lower Hand[/b]—are being added for players who just [i]have[/i] to gamble away their hard-earned gold.[/p][/*][*][p]Even more [b]furniture, food & drink[/b], and [b]Warehouse automation[/b] for restocking depleted goods are on the way, alongside essential balance updates and polish.

A hearty thanks to all ye who joined the Playtest! Your keen eyes and brave bug-slaying have shaped Tidehaven. We raise our mugs to you!

Please don't hesitate to [url="https://discord.gg/aBHDntjdQt"]join us on our Discord server[/url] and ask your questions to our dev team. And remember to [b]add TIDEHAVEN: Ale & Trade to your wishlist![/b] See you in the next post![/p][/*][/list]
